title: PAN
section: However, applicants can select one of the parents for name to be printed on the PAN card as mentioned at S. No.16. [ 14. Father’ Name](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/services/pan/instructions-form_95-form-96.html#14) To be filled as First Name/ Middle Name/Last Name. Married woman applicant shall give her father’s name and not husband’s name.  [ 15. Mother’s Name](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/services/pan/instructions-form_95-form-96.html#15) To be filled as First Name/ Middle Name/Last Name. [ 16. Parent Name to be printed on the PAN card ](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/services/pan/instructions-form_95-form-96.html#16) Applicant to select one of the parents whose name is to be printed on the PAN card. [ 17. AO Details ](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/services/pan/instructions-form_95-form-96.html#17) AO code (Area Code, AO Type, Range Code and AO Number) of the Jurisdictional Assessing Officer must be filled up by the applicant. These details can be obtained from the Income Tax Office or IT PAN Service Centers managed by UTIITSL/Protean or UTIITSL website www.utiitsl.com or Protean website www.tinpan.proteantech.in [ 18. Representative Assessee ](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/services/pan/instructions-form_95-form-96.html#18) [ 19. Permanent Account Number (if any) ](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/services/pan/instructions-form_95-form-96.html#19) PAN of Representative Assessee is to be given. [ 20. Aadhaar Number](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/services/pan/instructions-form_95-form-96.html#20) Aadhaar number is mandatory, if PAN of Representative Assessee is not available. [ 21. Representative Assessee Address](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/services/pan/instructions-form_95-form-96.html#21) In Part E, if Representative Assessee (RA) details are provided, it is mandatory to provide details of RA having Indian address (except for FPIs & minors). FPIs & minor can provide foreign address. [ 22. Contact Details ](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/services/pan/instructions-form_95-form-96.html#22) Mobile Number and Email address of Representative Assessee are mandatory [ 23. Address for Communication ](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/services/pan/instructions-form_95-form-96.html#23) Applicant to select one of the options as applicable for dispatch of PAN card.
